scope: Read-only Phase08 wet flat-bed n=0.03 source/reference component review, using static mathematics, existing focused-check receipts, saved native arrays and pinned local primary-source copies. The evolving forward-PINN training/evaluation module is excluded.
recommendation: No material source/reference defect found. This component pass supports the separately reviewed forward-PINN pilot and later protocol review; it is not a full-fit or full-pipeline release.

physical_source.notes: Drag opposes either discharge sign and vanishes at q=0 or n=0. Holding h fixed integrates q_new=q_old/(1+dt*g*n^2*abs(q_old)/h^(7/3)), preserving sign and reducing magnitude. There is no mass source.

nondimensional_residual.derivation: Divide physical Sq by Qc/Tc with Qc=H*Uc, Tc=Lc/Uc, Uc^2=gH. Coordinates remain x/Lc,t/Tc; no additional affine map is applied.
nondimensional_residual.notes: Tensor n and source h/q preserve parameter graphs. Uneven PDE chunks are weighted by their point fractions and IC/BC delegate to the unchanged core.

zero_n_limits.pinn: Scalar n=0 delegates directly to the unchanged core residual/component-loss paths. Existing CPU32 and CPU64 focused fixtures check exact residuals, PDE/IC/BC, weighted objective, all parameter gradients, one Adam update and optimizer state.
zero_n_limits.finite_volume: Zero-n source update is the identity. The independent HLLE reference approaches source-free analytical E1 cell averages under the saved200/400/800 refinement check; it need not equal the separate frozen Lax-Wendroff comparator.
zero_n_limits.limitation: Existing focused-check evidence is accepted with source/test hashes. No zero-n model or numerical solve was rerun; the saved zero-n receipt, not newly regenerated raw zero-n fields, is the evidence here.

numerical_method.notes: Piecewise-constant conservative HLLE with the pinned Einfeldt/Roe-average speed bounds, forward Euler homogeneous update and exact fixed-h drag after it. This is first-order Lie splitting. All actual interface speeds determine CFL<=0.5; steps hit requested times directly. Strictly positive finite input/intermediate/homogeneous/source states are required; no floor, clipping, retry or interpolation is present.

primary_context.notes: Saved pinned Clawpack Riemann-book cells match the HLLE wave estimates/intermediate state. Saved GeoClaw source has the7/3 denominator and1+dt*gamma decay denominator. GeoClaw depth switches, dry rules, speed limits, spherical and2D behavior are explicitly excluded; this review makes no general GeoClaw-equivalence claim.

saved_array_readback.method: Python/NumPy only; no production solver/source/model/reference functions were imported or called. Recomputed cumulative actual numerical boundary flux times each accepted dt, momentum source impulse, step and snapshot balances, conservative width-weighted native-cell coarsening, refinement differences and numerical fronts.
saved_array_readback.native_balance_interpretation: All saved step defects and cumulative source impulses agree exactly. Largest mass defect is1.6165e-13m² and momentum defect6.5816e-15m³/s. The selected final momentum2.3980753702m³/s combines the actual boundary contribution-2.427975m³/s and drag impulse-0.0298996298m³/s with the correct signs. Conservation is the discrete performed-scheme identity, not independent proof of continuum accuracy.
saved_array_readback.native_roundoff_note: Saved initial mixed-state sums differ from the exact prescribed5.5m² by up to4.55e-13; independent snapshot summation order differs by up to4.51e-13. These are reported floating-order differences, not physical initial bias or hidden mass adjustment.

common_cell_operator.independent_operator: Width-weighted sum of exactly aligned native cells over each common cell. This independently checks the implemented cumulative-integral/interpolated-edge conservative projection.
common_cell_operator.requirement_for_later_pinn: Neural predictions must be integrated over these same common cells with a declared converged quadrature; point predictions at centres are a different comparison operator and are not accepted by this component pass.

uncertainty_indicator.cellwise_rule: abs(N3200,CFL.45-N1600,CFL.45)+abs(N3200,CFL.225-N3200,CFL.45), each on the conservative common-cell operator
uncertainty_indicator.interpretation: Measured discretization-sensitivity indicator only. It is neither a rigorous error bound nor a statistical uncertainty interval; these runs do not establish an asymptotic convergence order.

numerical_front.rule: First downstream native interface attaining maximum negative adjacent-cell depth slope
numerical_front.notes: Across-run maximum front differences plus one selected dx define the position indicator. No analytical positive-friction shock trajectory is claimed.

zero_n_existing_receipt.quadrature: 16-node Gauss per native cell, exact E1 pointwise integrand

existing_verification.scope: Existing checks cover source signs/units/nonunit scales/manufactured residual and derivatives, core zero-n equality, fixed-h decay/ODE comparison, constant flat still water, actual drag budget, source-free refinement and projection. They are not evidence for nonflat well-balancing, dry states or inverse identifiability.

provenance_qualifications: The embedded case object is the immutable source-free E1 geometry/base-case record and still carries its original friction=none assumption. The governing n=.03 override is explicit in the extension config/protocol and source; later full-pipeline metadata must retain that distinction rather than presenting this as unchanged source-free E1 physics.

Per-cell homogeneous and post-source states at every internal step are not persisted. This review independently verifies the saved actual-step flux/impulse balances; source-update correctness also relies on the frozen implementation and existing decay/manufactured checks, not a forbidden solver replay.

Only source/reference components and their exact observed hashes were reviewed. No evolving forward training/evaluation module, full neural accuracy, final comparison quadrature or fit release is accepted here.
Prescribed illustrative n=.03 is not fitted, calibrated to a field site or shown identifiable. The problem remains flat, wet, source-free in mass and without rainfall/topography.
Reference is numerical with retained refinement indicators, not analytical friction ground truth. The isolated exact source substep does not make the coupled shallow-water solution exact.

preservation: Only this new review JSON was written. Existing source, config, reference arrays, receipts, core modules, archives and evolving experiment files were not edited.
